note: Starting parameters. Every threshold is a design decision - report the value you used and why.
coat_note: Tight range: excludes orange lanterns (hue ~13), lit windows (S < 195) and the brass clasp (V < 235).
drift_note: Wide range, measured ONLY inside the tracked box, so a coat that drifts from yellow to orange is still measured.
cut_note: A cut needs BOTH a pixel-difference jump above max(cut_min_diff, cut_ratio x the recent median) AND a histogram change above cut_min_hist. A flicker passes the first test and fails the second.
